# Exemplar Profile: IDP Module — Pluggable Document-Processing Construct Library

## Ask / Context

> TODO(interview): inferred from repo analysis only — not yet confirmed by
> the solution architect.

A reusable, npm-distributable IDP building-block library — "turn PDFs into
structured text/markdown with AI" — that multiple downstream CDK projects
compose, rather than a single deployed application (it is the
`@miketran/idp-module` package vendored by sibling repos). Inference
cost/flexibility was the core concern: consumers trade cost vs latency vs
data locality per deployment. The workload is bursty batch document
processing; the environment is compliance-conscious (private subnets, VPC
endpoints, KMS with TLS-deny policies look contractual). Velocity was
consciously prioritized over test coverage — unit tests are switched off and
verification happens against a live dev stage.

## Architecture & Why

> TODO(interview): inferred from repo analysis only — not yet confirmed by
> the solution architect.

A projen-managed jsii CDK construct library with a curated public surface
(five constructs, two sample stacks, helpers, types) and a three-layer
source split: `src/lib/` constructs (the product), `src/resources/lambda/`
runtime handlers, `src/shared/` synth-time and runtime helpers.

- **Three interchangeable inference backends behind one Step Functions/
  Lambda seam**: Bedrock (IAM or Bearer-token auth), SageMaker endpoints
  (real-time, async with queue-backlog autoscaling, serverless, plus
  custom-resource model lifecycle), and self-hosted DeepSeek-OCR on ECS/EC2
  GPU (vLLM FastAPI, ASG + ALB). Each backend exports a `LambdaInvoke` task
  for composition into state machines.
- **Event-driven processing spine**: S3 → SQS (+DLQ, SSL enforced) →
  processing Lambda → async SageMaker, with event-source mappings toggled by
  queue-depth thresholds (fast scale-out, slow scale-in).
- **Backend-agnostic config via environment with graceful fallback**: model
  ID accepts a plain string or a JSON array to fan one request out to
  multiple models in parallel; an optional API key switches Bedrock auth
  from IAM SigV4 to Bearer.
- **Security baseline on every stateful resource**: KMS + versioning +
  BLOCK_ALL + enforceSSL + access logging + explicit TLS-deny policies on
  buckets; DLQ + SSL on queues; key policies conditioned on
  ViaService/SourceArn.

## Key Patterns

- Deterministic naming helper (`getCdkConstructId`) building
  `<app>-<stage>-<context>-<resource>` from env vars — stage-prefixed deploy
  targeting via `cdk deploy 'dev-*'`.
- IAM helpers that compress policy boilerplate: a default Lambda role
  factory plus a `{service, operations, resources}` policy-statement
  shorthand composed by every construct.
- Lambda factory convention with dual entry resolution: `index.ts` resolves
  `handler.ts` (in-repo dev) vs `handler.js` (published package) via
  filesystem probe, so bundled Lambdas work both ways.
- Projen self-mutation CI: the build regenerates config, diffs, and uploads
  a patch — the repo cannot silently diverge from `.projenrc.ts`.
- jsii-compatible readonly-props interfaces with `@default`/`@example`
  JSDoc; API.md auto-generated by jsii-docgen.
- The Docker directory doubles as a standalone local dev environment
  (compose file, FastAPI server, batch processors, its own README).
- Anti-patterns flagged, not imitated: tests deliberately disabled,
  commented-out pipeline code in the sample stack, a placeholder README.
